findings.claim: UploadZone.handleDragEnter's overlay condition now also accepts `dataTransfer.files.length > 0`, which the original `types.includes("Files")` check did not, and this applies to folder pages as well as the search page.
findings.impact: Browsers normally report an empty `files` list at dragenter, so in practice the added term is a no-op, but it is an unrequested change to the existing upload overlay path that I8 says must not change.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/UploadZone.tsx:62-67: `hasFiles = types.includes("Files") || files.length > 0`; with acceptUpload defaulting to true and no onImageQuery, this differs from the pre-change condition. No test covers the folder-page overlay with this input.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant is observably broken; the extra term is almost certainly inert and only widens the diff to a protected-by-intent path.

findings.claim: Spec prose (step 0 and step 2: 'every drop on the results page goes to the upload zone as today', 'uploads exactly as before') still describes uploads on the text-query page, while the code now does nothing for an upload-class drop there.
findings.impact: A reader of the spec could change the code back to uploading from the search page.
findings.evidence: docs/specs/image-query-search.md step 0 and I8 text versus FolderBrowser.tsx:903-915 with acceptUpload={false} and UploadZone.tsx:109.

bucket_proposal.reason: Prose disagreement only; the code matches the actual pre-change behaviour (no upload on the search page).

findings.proposed_fix: Delete the 'uploads as today' claim for the text-query page from the spec.

specification_compliance: The r1 findings F1/V1 are fixed in code: FolderBrowser.tsx:903-915 passes acceptUpload={false} on the search branch, and UploadZone.tsx:109 returns before any addFiles/addFileEntries call, so an upload-class drop does nothing and shows no overlay.

The 'upload-files' custom event, the only other route into the zone's upload code, is dispatched only by useFilePicker/AddButton. FolderToolbar renders AddButton only when isWriteDestination holds, which requires isLocation, which is false on the search page. So the new zone does not open an upload path there.
A one-image drop still calls onImageQuery and never uploads, as in I8.
Folder pages keep uploads (acceptUpload defaults to true, onImageQuery undefined).
potential_unspecified_behavior: The overlay condition on folder pages gained an extra `files.length > 0` term (F1).
regression_risks: Any later code that dispatches 'upload-files' while the search page is mounted would now be heard by the search page's zone, which uploads into the drive root even with acceptUpload={false}. The listener at UploadZone.tsx:37-52 does not check acceptUpload.
The upload overlay on folder pages depends on the changed hasFiles condition.
test_coverage: UploadZone.noUpload.test.tsx covers non-image, several images, folder, text-selection and one-image drops with acceptUpload off.
FolderBrowser.imageQuery.upload.test.tsx checks the prop passed on the search branch and its absence on a folder page; the zone is mocked there.
No test dispatches 'upload-files' to a zone with acceptUpload={false}, and none checks the folder-page overlay for a non-file drag.
not_verified: Addon Python code, which this commit does not touch.
Nothing was run; findings come from reading UploadZone.tsx, FolderBrowser.tsx, useFilePicker.tsx and FolderToolbar.tsx.
Real-browser values of dataTransfer.files at dragenter.
Other callers of UploadZone and dispatchUploadEvent outside the files grepped.
trajectory: The one fix commit since r1 adds a single boolean prop, acceptUpload, with one guard in handleDrop and a changed overlay condition. It removes the r1 defect (upload-class drops and non-file overlays on the search page) and adds no state or prediction. The overlay condition is simpler than r1's, though it picked up the extra `files.length` term. Round one's flaw was a missing guard, and this round supplies it, so I see no patching trend yet.
